d: Sealy Mattress Middle East is seeking a dedicated and results-driven Retail Salesperson to represent our globally recognized sleep brand. In this role, you will guide customers through their sleep journey, provide expert product recommendations, and deliver an exceptional showroom experience that drives sales and builds lasting brand loyalty.
q: Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, or a related field.
Experience: Minimum of 5 years of proven experience in retail sales (experience in mattresses, bedding, luxury furniture, or home furnishings is strongly preferred).
Language: Fluency in Arabic and good working proficiency in English.
Strong interpersonal, communication, and active listening skills.
Persuasive negotiation and closing abilities with a customer-first mindset.
Professional appearance, approachable demeanor, and high energy.
Proficiency in MS Office and retail POS/ERP systems.
Flexibility to work retail shifts, including evenings, weekends, and public holidays.
r: Consultative Selling: Greet customers warmly, assess their sleep habits, comfort preferences, and health needs, and recommend tailored Sealy mattress and bedding solutions.
Product Demonstration: Effectively communicate the features, benefits, and proprietary technologies of Sealy products, encouraging customers to test mattresses in-store.
Sales & Target Achievement: Consistently meet or exceed monthly and quarterly individual and showroom sales targets.
Customer Relationship Management: Follow up with prospective buyers, manage post-sale inquiries, and resolve customer complaints promptly to ensure high satisfaction.
Showroom Maintenance: Maintain high visual merchandising standards, ensuring all displays, beds, and promotional materials are clean, organized, and properly priced.
Sales Administration: Accurately process sales orders, invoices, payments, and delivery schedules using the company’s ERP/POS system.
Market Awareness: Stay informed on product updates, ongoing promotions, and competitor offerings within the Saudi bedding and furniture market.
